title: Phantom Ten
description:
15-meter corridor.

Do not miss the anomalies.
If you don't see anomalies, go out the door on the right.
If you see anomalies, go out the door on the left.
The game will not end until 10:00.

A horror game to find the anomalies.
You only have to follow a one-way corridor.
There are no items to collect, no puzzles to solve, and no hiding, running, or fighting.Phantoms33Game modesStandard mode: If you make a mistake, you start over from midnight.
Easy mode: If you make a mistake, you go back one hour.
Anomalies collection mode: Anomalies will always occur.Gallery settingYou can specify the phantom that will occur next time.ControlsMovement: Left stick / WASD
Camera: Right stick / Mouse
Menu: Options button / Esc
